# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, basements and ADU conversions in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. Part of P5 Home Co. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Garden City, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell, across Ada County and Canyon County. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Garden City, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, and Caldwell, across Ada County and Canyon County. Phone (208) 477-1169. Email hello@boiseremodeling.co. Idaho Registered Contractor #8381215 and insured.

P5 Home Co, Meridian, ID 83646 (service-area business, no public street). Phone (208) 477-1169. Web https://p5homeco.com.
Boise Remodeling Co: https://boiseremodeling.co.

Design-build means one accountable team handles design direction, estimating, Ada and Canyon County permitting, and construction as one accountable company with one point of contact, backed by a written scope before work starts and a one-year workmanship guarantee from documented Final Completion. Preliminary price ranges come from the instant estimate (https://boiseremodeling.co/instant-estimate), which prices the room, the scope and the finish level rather than a flat price per square foot; they are preliminary ranges, not quotes, and a firm proposal follows a free in-home visit.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/kitchen-remodel): Custom kitchen renovations from cabinet refreshes to full gut-and-rebuild.
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/bathroom-remodel): Spa-quality bathroom transformations designed around how you actually live.
- [Whole-Home Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/whole-home-remodel): Cohesive whole-home renovations with a single project manager start to finish.
- [Room Addition](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/room-addition): Thoughtfully designed additions that feel like they were always part of your home.
- [ADU conversions](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/adu): Garage, basement and attached spaces turned into accessory dwelling units. New detached ADUs are built by Boise Construction Co (https://boiseconstruction.co/services/adu).
- [Basement Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/basement-remodel): Finished basements and lower-level living space, from egress and framing to a fully finished suite.
- [Outdoor Living & Decks](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/outdoor-living): Decks, covered patios, and outdoor kitchens that extend your living space into the yard.
- [Aging-in-Place Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/aging-in-place): Accessible, safe, and stylish remodels that let you stay in the home you love for the long term.
- [RE-10 repairs (Boise Handyman Co)](https://boisehandyman.co/re-10-repairs-boise): repairs from an Idaho RE-10 inspection response, completed and documented before closing, for real estate agents, buyers and sellers.
- [Send your remodel plans](https://boiseremodeling.co/remodel-plans-boise): attach floor plans, schedules, photos and documents to a project request. The team reviews the drawings and the scope before preparing an estimate; no price is shown from the drawings on the page. Free, with no obligation.
- [All Services](https://boiseremodeling.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boiseremodeling.co/areas).
